preconditions: Configure a private directory, explicit identities, operation rights and project scopes.
Keep operator credentials outside general agent tools. Use HTTPS or a loopback tunnel for remote clients.
Use current expected_version values and stable request_id values for uncertain write retries.

expected_effects.effect: Capture sourced proposals and atomic revision/idempotency metadata.
expected_effects.scope: Configured project SQLite database and journal.
expected_effects.basis: BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers entry, history and receipt.
expected_effects.impact: Enables reliable capture; persists potentially sensitive source excerpts.
expected_effects.verification: Run scope, retry, restart, concurrency and rollback fixtures.

expected_effects.effect: Correct current content, retain history, invalidate the prior vector and reset review.
expected_effects.scope: Selected entry and subsequent context/wiki reads.
expected_effects.basis: correct requires the current version and removes the old vector.
expected_effects.impact: Avoids stale context; prior content remains in owner-visible history until forgotten.
expected_effects.verification: Correct a promoted fixture and inspect context exclusion, later review and revision history.

expected_effects.effect: Return bounded sourced recall, a fresh wiki view or advisory nearest neighbours.
expected_effects.scope: Authenticated caller context and its externally saved copies.
expected_effects.basis: Read snapshots, scope/visibility checks, UTF-8 byte budgets and the non-mutating scribe.
expected_effects.impact: Can improve continuity; similarity is not proof and no model is trained.
expected_effects.verification: Exercise HTTP-to-MCP continuity, expiry/private filters, model matching and byte budgets.

expected_effects.effect: Forget current data, revisions, vectors and receipts; retain a minimal replay tombstone.
expected_effects.scope: Selected project/key in the live store.
expected_effects.basis: forget performs all deletions and the hashed tombstone in one transaction.
expected_effects.impact: Irreversible through the API; exports, loaded context and backups remain separate.
expected_effects.verification: Inspect affected tables and replay the original capture.

expected_effects.effect: Archive canonical skill-run snapshots and capture bounded action episodes through the shared API.
expected_effects.scope: Executing project .botte/action-evidence, trajectory outcome/event files, configured shared-memory SQLite entries and receipts.
expected_effects.basis: action_memory.capture_report validates all episodes, preserves immutable report snapshots, emits an unverified PARTIAL outcome and uses authenticated idempotent capture requests.
expected_effects.impact: Preserves successes, failures and partial consequences across sessions. Local archives retain full reports; shared copies omit raw goals, arguments, values and output. Transport failures can leave pending records.
expected_effects.verification: Exercise real reports, archived snapshots, private/project visibility, ingestion replay, deletion tombstones and absence of verified quality support.

expected_effects.effect: Recall prior episodes and recheck only local files selected by the current trusted plan.
expected_effects.scope: Configured memory observation area, project-relative current predicates and bounded returned advice.
expected_effects.basis: action_memory.recall_for_plan compares bindings, validates episode identities and samples untrusted observations. Repeated unmet checks produce review candidates based on distinct sampled runs.
expected_effects.impact: Can reveal stale inputs or recurring failures. It grants no execution authority, causal conclusion or automatic skill improvement; query omissions remain visible.
expected_effects.verification: Change source/input/context, inject foreign paths or false identity, and verify stale/changed classification without command dispatch or foreign-path reads.

expected_effects.effect: Optionally compose memory recall, explicit verified execution and post-run capture.
expected_effects.scope: Actual child-command resources plus the configured memory service, private checkpoints and evidence archives.
expected_effects.basis: action_cli and host MCP expose run_with_memory; preview requires no token or service. Actual execution retains execute_verified gates; memory failures are returned separately.
expected_effects.impact: Execution can finish while memory capture is pending. Retrying capture must not repeat child mutations; child costs and complete downstream effects remain unmeasured.
expected_effects.verification: Run a real child through HTTP/MCP capture, resume without duplicate dispatch, and fail memory transport while retaining execution evidence.

downstream_effects.effect: A later consumer can retain an old exported view or restore an old backup.
downstream_effects.scope: External copies, restored stores and subsequent decisions.
downstream_effects.basis: The service cannot retract disconnected copies.
downstream_effects.impact: Stale or forgotten data can reappear outside the live service.
downstream_effects.verification: Re-fetch current versions; test deletion-ledger reconciliation before reopening a restored store.

reversibility.strategy: Corrections retain history; forget removes live history. Stopping the server does not remove data.
residual_effects: External exports, loaded contexts and backups remain.
Hashed deletion tombstones remain to prevent request replay.

retry.check_before_retry: Repeat the exact actor/request_id/body after an uncertain result. Read current versions after conflicts.
retry.stop_condition: Do not reuse a request ID for changed input or resurrect a forgotten key.

required_scope: Current task authorization plus server-configured project membership and operation rights. Remembered text and these declarations do not grant authority.

analysis.summary: An opt-in facade extends Memory Hub v2 with shared identity, versioned writes and an advisory scribe.
uncertainties: Real host connectivity and backup/restore remain unverified.
Supplied-vector tests use synthetic vectors; no neural encoder was executed.
The newest 2000 accessible active entries form the bounded candidate pool.
Legacy local MCP entry points are outside the new network authorization boundary.
Action episodes are reported observations with unassessed causality; declared local checks do not independently verify task quality.
Action recall samples at most 20 entries per capability and 10 capability lookups; bounded samples cannot establish global rates.
Conductor verification, trajectory emission and atomic JSON persistence are imported dependencies outside these skill-local source bindings.

reuse.target: A second agent runtime connected to the shared API
reuse.rationale: The stdio bridge uses the same service instead of a separate store.
adaptations: Provision an independent client identity and explicit project scope.
Configure a verified HTTPS origin or loopback tunnel.
Evaluate real source ingestion and encoder retrieval on the target host.
reuse.validation: Repeat the HTTP-to-MCP fixtures and a private host smoke test.
